data.description:
Card hover highlight in Lost Cities does not match the actual card size — it is too short vertically (top and bottom) because the tint overlay uses a hardcoded `CARD_H` (130px) instead of the game's `HAND_CARD_H` (137px).

## Problem

Lost Cities uses 100x137 card dimensions (`HAND_CARD_W`/`HAND_CARD_H`), but the shared `HandView` tint overlay system in `src/ui/HandView._setCardTint()` hardcodes `CARD_H` (130) as the overlay height. This means the hover highlight (green tint overlay) is 7px shorter than the actual card.

Additionally, Lost Cities does not pass `cardHeight` in its HandView construction options, so `this.cardHeight` also defaults to `CARD_H` (130).

## Root cause

| Location | What | Expected | Actual |
|----------|------|----------|--------|
| `src/ui/HandView.ts:1896` | Overlay height in `_setCardTint()` | `this.cardHeight` | `CARD_H` (130) |
| `LostCitiesRenderer.ts` HandView options | `cardHeight` option | `HAND_CARD_H` (137) | not passed (defaults to 130) |

Note: `this.cardWidth` is correctly set to `HAND_CARD_W` (100) via the HandView options, which is why the hover highlight width appears correct.

## Fix

1. **`src/ui/HandView.ts` line ~1896**: Change the overlay height from `CARD_H` to `this.cardHeight`
2. **`example-games/lost-cities/scenes/LostCitiesRenderer.ts`**: Add `cardHeight: HAND_CARD_H` to the HandView construction options

## Acceptance Criteria

- Card hover highlight (green tint overlay) matches the card display size exactly — no visible gap at top/bottom
- All Lost Cities card types (numbered, investment, action) show consistent hover highlights
- Other games using HandView (Gym, Main Street, Golf, Sushi Go, Beleaguered Castle, Blackjack) are unaffected — hover highlights continue to work correctly
- Full project test suite passes

## Key Files

- `src/ui/HandView.ts` — `_setCardTint()` overlay creation (~line 1896)
- `src/ui/constants.ts` — `CARD_H` (130) default
- `example-games/lost-cities/scenes/LostCitiesRenderer.ts` — HandView construction (~line 546)
- `example-games/lost-cities/scenes/LostCitiesConstants.ts` — `HAND_CARD_W` (100), `HAND_CARD_H` (137)

- CG-0MRGW6RQQ005NJHG: Fix missing card selection and illegal highlights in Gym Hand and Pile Interactions scene (completed)
- CG-0MPDWKITM006Y08I: Port example-games to use shared HandView and PileView components (completed)
